content: This comparison also highlights the conceptual difference between our multi-scale methodology and LDA topic modelling. While LDA computes topics at a pre-determined level of resolution, our method obtains partitions at all resolutions in one sweep of the Markov time, from which relevant partitions are chosen based on their robustness. However, the MS partitions at all resolutions are available for further investigation if so needed.
